t: Protocol Implementation Builder - public implementations survey
title: Protocol Implementation Builder - public implementations survey
definition: Implements a documented communication protocol.
description:
Protocol Implementation Builder is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Implements a documented communication protocol. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Protocol Implementation Builder. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Protocol Implementation Builder. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Protocol Implementation Builder capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

t: TCP/IP - related Protocol Implementation Builder technology
title: TCP/IP - related Protocol Implementation Builder technology
definition: The internet's packet protocols.
description:
TCP/IP is not itself a Protocol Implementation Builder, but it belongs in this survey because real Protocol Implementation Builder work leans on it. The internet's packet protocols.

In a Protocol Implementation Builder build it shows up when startup speed beats raw peak power. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Protocol Implementation Builder practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, TCP/IP is a dependable workhorse as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Protocol Implemen
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Protocol Implemen
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Protocol Implementation Builder from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Protocol Implementation Builder from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Protocol Implementation Builder needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
